modules.title: Problem and constraints
modules.prompt: Choose one real customer journey. Describe who needs it, the present failure, a measurable outcome and the constraints. Identify what the project will deliberately leave out.

modules.title: Boundaries and data
modules.prompt: Name each component, its owner and the data crossing its boundary. Explain what is stored, where it is stored, and how a customer can export or remove it.

modules.title: Permissions and privacy
modules.prompt: Show the customer, partner and reviewer permissions. Include one negative test proving that an unrelated customer cannot read or change the request.

modules.title: Integrations and failure
modules.prompt: Identify one external dependency. Show what happens on a timeout, a duplicate submission and an unavailable dependency, including how the person can recover.

modules.title: Testing and accessibility
modules.prompt: Provide a runnable check command and evidence for the main journey at 320px and desktop width. Include keyboard navigation, labels and an error-and-retry path.

modules.title: Deployment and handover
modules.prompt: Show a reproducible deployment, a preview, rollback steps and a short handover. Identify unresolved dependencies and the person responsible for each one.
